# Posts

jekyll-theme-minimal has no post-listing layout, so this page builds one.

<ul class="post-list">
{% for post in site.posts %}
  <li>
    <a href="{{ post.url | relative_url }}">{{ post.title }}</a>
    <br>
    <small>{{ post.date | date: "%-d %B %Y" }}{% if post.description %} — {{ post.description }}{% endif %}</small>
  </li>
{% endfor %}
</ul>

<style>
.post-list { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; }
.post-list li { margin-bottom: 1.1em; }
.post-list small { color: #767676; }
</style>
